_doc: English menu text for NSN2 (SLPS-02120). One entry per on-screen text. 'kind' A = pre-rendered texture label (image edit at identical size), B = atlas glyph string, C = dialogue-system message. Owner rule: textures keep their exact size and are never stretched; if the English does not fit comfortably, use the 'fallback' wording.

熱血青春日記2.why: Literal 'Hot-Blooded Youth Diary 2', shortened to fit menu labels; used consistently everywhere.

一人で遊ぶ.why: 1-player arcade mode, as in Rival Schools USA.

協力戦.why: Rival Schools USA used 'Cooperation'; 'Co-op' if the label is too tight.

試験に出る実技'99.why: Practical-exam practice mode; keeps the '99 tag.

五輪祭.why: Gorin is the school name (Gorin High); 祭 = festival.

現在のポイント.why: Current point total; short to fit the label strip.

主役.why: Main character of a pair, as in Rival Schools USA.

labels.source: MENU.BIZ TIM #2 (VRAM 512,256), two label sizes + list column

descriptions.source: MENU.BIZ TIM #3-#16 (VRAM 832,256), 176x112 px each, palette supplied in VRAM; Japanese uses up to 5 lines
